privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
# Privacy Policy

**Effective from 1 October 2026**

This Privacy Policy explains how Zodiac Pluss ("**Zodiac Pluss**", "we", "us") collects, uses, shares and protects your personal data when you use the Zodiac Pluss apps and website (together, the "**Services**"). We act as the data fiduciary for the data you give us, under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the rules made under them.

By creating an account you confirm that you have read this policy. Where the law requires your consent for a particular use, we ask for it separately and you can withdraw it at any time (see "Your rights").

## 1. What we collect

**Account details.** Your name, mobile number, email address, profile photo, language and notification preferences. You sign in with a one-time password sent by SMS.

**Birth details.** If you use astrology features, the date, time and place of birth you enter, and the charts and readings produced from them. Birth details are personal to you; we ask only for what the features need.

**Your conversations.** Messages, images, files and videos you send to experts, and the notes and summaries of your sessions. Chats with astrologers are stored on our servers so that you and the astrologer can see the conversation history.

**Calls.** Voice and video calls with experts are carried by our calling provider. We keep a record of each session (who, when, how long and what it cost). **Voice calls with astrologers are recorded** (see section 3).

**Wellbeing information.** If you use the wellness tools, the mood entries, journal entries, exercise history and answers to assessments you choose to submit. This can be sensitive, so we use it only to run those features for you and to keep you safe (section 4).

**Payments.** Wallet recharges and payments are processed by Razorpay. We receive the amount, status and a payment reference; **we do not receive or store your full card, UPI PIN or net-banking details.** We keep a ledger of your wallet and Zodiac Coin balance and transactions.

**If you are an expert.** Your identity and qualification documents (KYC), certificates, profile and availability, and the bank details we need to pay you.

**Technical data.** Device and app version, platform, push-notification token, IP address and basic logs, used for security, fraud prevention and to make the app work.

**Support.** What you send us when you contact support or report something.

## 2. How we use your data

- To create and run your account, connect you with experts, and deliver sessions, bookings and notifications.
- To take payments, run the wallet, pay experts and keep the financial and tax records the law requires.
- To keep the Services safe: preventing fraud and abuse, enforcing our Community Guidelines, and responding to risks to someone's safety.
- To provide support and resolve disputes, including by looking at a session when you or an expert raise a complaint about it.
- To improve the Services, using aggregated or de-identified information wherever we can.
- To meet legal obligations and respond to lawful requests from authorities.

We do not sell your personal data, and we do not use your conversations or recordings to show you advertising.

## 3. Recording of astrology calls

**Voice calls with astrologers are recorded automatically.** We do not ask again before each call; this notice is how we tell you. By taking a call with an astrologer on Zodiac Pluss you agree to it being recorded.

- **What is recorded:** the audio of the call, from the moment the recording starts, which can be a few seconds after the call connects.
- **Why:** so that you and the astrologer can listen again to what was said, and so that we can look into complaints, disputes and safety reports.
- **Who can listen:** you and the astrologer on that call can play the recording from the session chat. Our staff can open it only for support, safety, dispute or legal reasons, and each such access is logged with the reason.
- **Where it is kept:** in private cloud storage with access controls. It is not public, and the link used to play it is short-lived.
- **How long:** a recording is part of your session history and is kept for as long as that history is kept, or until deleted as described in section 7. You can ask us to delete a recording by writing to info@zodiacpluss.com.
- **Not recorded:** therapy and counselling sessions (chat, voice or video) with psychologists, and astrology chat conversations, are never recorded as audio. Your employer, if you use an employer-sponsored plan, never has access to any recording.

If you do not want a call recorded, do not take the call; you can use astrology chat instead.

## 4. Therapy, counselling and safety

Sessions with psychologists are private. They are never recorded. Therapy chats are end-to-end encrypted on app versions that support it, which means that in those chats only you and your therapist can read the messages and we cannot.

If we have good reason to believe that someone is at serious and immediate risk of harming themselves or others, we may take steps to protect them, including contacting emergency services or a person you have named, sharing only what is necessary. If you are in distress, you can call Tele-MANAS on 14416 (free, India) at any time.

Zodiac Pluss is not an emergency service.

## 5. Who we share data with

- **The expert you consult** sees what they need to help you: your name, the birth details you share, and your conversation. Experts must keep client information confidential (see the Expert Agreement).
- **Service providers** who process data for us under contract: cloud hosting and database (Supabase, Render), media storage (Cloudflare R2, Amazon Web Services S3), voice and video calling and call recording (Agora), payments (Razorpay), SMS and one-time passwords (MSG91) and push notifications (Google Firebase Cloud Messaging). They may process data outside India. We choose providers that protect data to a standard comparable to this policy.
- **Your employer, if you use an employer-sponsored (EAP) plan:** only usage statistics (for example, how many sessions the plan has been used for). Never the content of any session, chat, journal or recording, and not what you discussed.
- **Authorities and others, where the law requires** or to protect rights, safety or property.
- **A buyer or successor,** if our business is sold or merged, on the same terms as this policy.

## 6. Notifications

We send service notifications (sessions, bookings, payments, safety and account notices). You can switch off promotional and wellness notifications in the app. Service and security notices cannot be switched off.

## 7. How long we keep data, and deleting your account

We keep personal data only as long as we need it for the purposes above and as the law requires.

You can delete your account in the app. Deletion starts a grace period of **60 days for users and 30 days for experts**, during which signing in again cancels it. When it ends we permanently delete your account and personal data, except records we must keep by law (for example payment, invoice and tax records) and information needed for an open dispute or a legal claim. **Any wallet balance and Zodiac Coins remaining at that point are forfeited.** We cannot delete an account while a session is live, a booking is confirmed or a payout is unsettled.

To ask for a recording or other data to be deleted without closing your account, write to info@zodiacpluss.com.

## 8. Security

We use encryption in transit, access controls, audit logs and private storage with short-lived access links. No system is completely secure. If a breach affects your personal data we will tell you and the authorities as the law requires.

## 9. Your rights

You can ask us to:

- tell you what personal data we hold about you and how it is used;
- correct or update it (you can edit most of it in the app);
- erase it (see section 7);
- withdraw a consent you gave, which does not affect what was done before you withdrew it;
- respond to a complaint about how we handle your data; and
- nominate someone to exercise these rights for you if you die or cannot do so yourself.

Write to info@zodiacpluss.com. We will verify that it is you and respond within the time the law allows. If you are not satisfied, you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

## 10. Children

Zodiac Pluss is for people who are **18 or older**. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone younger. If you believe a child has given us data, tell us and we will delete it.

## 11. Our website

The website may use cookies and similar tools that are needed to make it work, and, where you allow them, to understand how it is used. You can control cookies in your browser.

## 12. Changes to this policy

When we change this policy in a way that matters, we publish a new version and ask you to accept it before you keep using the Services. The version and date are shown at the top.

## 13. Contact and grievance officer

Zodiac Pluss
Building no. 199, Pocket 20, North West Delhi, New Delhi - 110085

**Grievance Officer:** Kumari Shweta
Email: info@zodiacpluss.com
Hours: 9 AM - 5 PM

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.content:
# Terms & Conditions

**Effective from 1 October 2026**

These Terms & Conditions ("**Terms**") are an agreement between you and Zodiac Pluss ("**Zodiac Pluss**", "we", "us") about your use of the Zodiac Pluss apps and website (the "**Services**"). Please read them with our Privacy Policy, Refund Policy, Wallet Policy and Community Guidelines, which form part of these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the Services.

## 1. What Zodiac Pluss is

Zodiac Pluss is a platform that connects people ("**users**") with independent experts ("**experts**"): astrologers, and psychologists and counsellors who offer therapy and wellbeing support. We also provide wellness tools such as mood and journal tracking, exercises, assessments and birth-chart features.

Experts are independent professionals, not our employees. We provide the platform, payments and support; the advice itself is the expert's.

## 2. Who can use it

You must be **18 or older**, be able to enter a binding contract under Indian law, and give accurate information. You are responsible for what happens under your account and for keeping your sign-in details safe. One person, one account. Tell us at once if you think someone else has used yours.

## 3. Important: what the Services are not

- **Astrology is guidance, not fact.** Astrologers give their interpretation for reflection and personal guidance. Nothing is guaranteed, and nothing an astrologer says is a substitute for professional medical, psychological, legal or financial advice. Make your own decisions.
- **Therapy and wellness tools are not emergency care.** If you or someone else may be in danger, call your local emergency number or Tele-MANAS on 14416 (free, India). Do not wait for a booked session.
- **Wellness tools and assessments** are for self-understanding. They do not diagnose any condition.

## 4. Sessions, bookings and prices

- **Instant sessions** (chat, voice or video with an available expert) are charged **per minute** at the expert's listed price, from your wallet, while the session is connected. The session ends when your balance runs out unless you add funds.
- **Bookings** (scheduled therapy and other appointments) are for a fixed time and price shown before you pay, and must be paid within 15 minutes of booking or they lapse.
- **Urgent therapy chat** connects you to a therapist who is online now. You are charged only when the therapist accepts.
- **Taxes.** GST at 18% is added to bookings where it applies, and shown before you pay.
- **Cancellations and refunds** are governed by the Refund Policy.
- Prices, offers and coupons can change. The price shown when you start or pay is the price you are charged. Coupons have their own conditions and cannot be exchanged for cash.

## 5. Recording

Voice calls with astrologers are recorded automatically so that you and the astrologer can replay them and so that we can look into complaints and safety reports. Details, including how long they are kept and who can listen, are in the Privacy Policy. Therapy and counselling sessions are never recorded. You must not record, screenshot or share a session yourself without the other person's permission.

## 6. Your conduct

You agree to follow the Community Guidelines. In particular you will not harass, threaten or abuse experts or other users; ask experts to take you off the platform to avoid fees; share anyone's personal details without permission; use the Services for anything unlawful; attempt to break, scrape or overload the Services; or pretend to be someone else.

## 7. Your content

You own what you send. You give us a limited licence to store, process and show it as needed to run the Services and the features you use. We do not use your private conversations to advertise to you.

## 8. Our rights

The Services, the brand, software and content we provide are ours or our licensors'. You may use them for your personal use only. We may suspend or end an account, or remove content, if you break these Terms or the law, for the safety of others, or to protect the Services. If we end your account for something you did wrong, no refund is owed for unused promotional credit.

## 9. Wallet and Zodiac Coins

The wallet and Zodiac Coins are explained in the Wallet Policy. They are prepaid credit for use on Zodiac Pluss only and cannot be transferred, sold or withdrawn.

## 10. Third parties

Payments are handled by Razorpay, calls by Agora and so on (see the Privacy Policy). Their own terms apply to the part they provide. We are not responsible for a service we do not control being unavailable, though we will help you if it affects a payment or a session.

## 11. Our responsibility

The Services are provided "as is" and "as available". We work hard to keep them running but cannot promise they will be uninterrupted or error-free, or that any expert's advice will suit you. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, or for the advice or conduct of experts, who are independent. Our total liability to you for any claim about the Services is limited to the amount you paid us for the session or booking the claim is about. Nothing here limits liability that cannot be limited by law, including for fraud or for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, and nothing limits your rights under consumer protection law.

## 12. Ending your account

You can delete your account in the app; what happens next is in the Privacy Policy. Sections that by their nature should continue after the account ends (such as 11, 13 and 14) do.

## 13. Disputes and governing law

These Terms are governed by the laws of India. If you have a problem, write to us first at info@zodiacpluss.com and we will try to resolve it. Courts at Delhi, India have exclusive jurisdiction, subject to any right you have under consumer law to bring a case where you live.

## 14. Changes

We may update these Terms. When a change matters, we publish a new version and ask you to accept it before you carry on. If you do not accept, you may close your account.

## 15. Contact and grievances

Zodiac Pluss
Building no. 199, Pocket 20, North West Delhi, New Delhi - 110085

**Grievance Officer:** Kumari Shweta
Email: info@zodiacpluss.com
Hours: 9 AM - 5 PM

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.content:
# Refund Policy

**Effective from 1 October 2026**

This policy explains when Zodiac Pluss ("**Zodiac Pluss**", "we", "us") refunds money, and how. It forms part of our Terms & Conditions.

## 1. Where refunds go

A refund goes back to where the money came from:

- the part you paid from your **wallet** returns to your wallet;
- the part you paid with **Zodiac Coins** returns as Zodiac Coins;
- the part you paid by **UPI, card or net banking** (through Razorpay) returns to the original payment method. Banks usually take 5 to 7 working days after we approve it.

If a booking was paid from more than one of these, each part is refunded to its own source.

## 2. Booked appointments

- **Cancelled by you, or by the expert:** a single booked appointment is refunded **in full**, whoever cancels it.
- **Part of a course (bundle):** if you cancel one appointment of a course, you get back that appointment's full share of the course price, whether or not the course has started. If the expert cancels, the same applies.
- **Unanswered or declined:** if an expert does not respond to a booking or an urgent therapy request, or declines it, you are not charged, or you are refunded in full.
- **Not paid in time:** a booking that is not paid within 15 minutes lapses and nothing is charged.

GST charged on a refunded booking is refunded with it.

## 3. Instant sessions (chat, voice, video)

Instant sessions are charged per minute while connected. You are not charged for time when the session was not connected, and a request that the expert does not answer costs nothing.

If a session was interrupted or was of clearly poor quality because of a problem on our side or the expert's, write to info@zodiacpluss.com within **7 days** with the date and time of the session. We will review it, look at the session record, and refund the affected minutes where the problem is confirmed.

We cannot refund a session simply because you disliked the advice or the prediction did not come true, as the advice is the expert's own opinion. See section 5 for conduct complaints.

## 4. Wallet recharges

Money you add to your wallet stays in your wallet and is used for sessions and bookings. It is **not** refundable to your bank except where the law requires it, or where a recharge was made in error or charged twice. If you were charged twice or a payment was deducted but not credited, write to us and we will credit the wallet or reverse the charge. Promotional credit and coupons are not refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash.

## 5. Complaints about an expert

If an expert behaved improperly, was abusive, or broke our Community Guidelines, report it in the app or write to info@zodiacpluss.com. We will investigate, and where the complaint is upheld we will refund the session.

## 6. When a refund is not available

- Time actually used in a connected session that you were satisfied to continue.
- Promotional credit, coupons and offer balances.
- Misuse of the Services, or a claim we find to be false.
- Your account being closed for breaking the Terms.

## 7. How to ask

In the app, open the session or booking and report the problem, or write to info@zodiacpluss.com with your registered mobile number and the booking or session details. We aim to reply within 2 working days, and tell you the outcome and, where it is a refund, when to expect it.

Nothing in this policy limits your rights under consumer protection law.

**Contact:** Zodiac Pluss, Building no. 199, Pocket 20, North West Delhi, New Delhi - 110085 · info@zodiacpluss.com

wallet.title: Wallet Policy
wallet.content:
# Wallet Policy

**Effective from 2 October 2026**

This policy explains how the Zodiac Pluss wallet and Zodiac Coins work. It forms part of the Terms & Conditions of Zodiac Pluss ("**Zodiac Pluss**", "we", "us").

## 1. What the wallet holds

Your wallet holds two kinds of balance:

- **Money (₹).** Funds you add by UPI, card or net banking through Razorpay, and refunds credited back to you.
- **Zodiac Coins.** A prepaid unit you can use in the same places as money. **100 Zodiac Coins are worth ₹1.** Coins are credited when you buy or are given them (for example in an offer), and are shown separately from your money balance.

## 2. Using your balance

Your balance pays for sessions and bookings on Zodiac Pluss. For a purchase that uses both, the app shows how it is split before you confirm. If your balance does not cover a purchase, you can pay the rest by UPI, card or net banking. Instant sessions are charged per minute and end when your balance runs out unless you add more.

## 3. Adding money

Recharges are made through Razorpay. We never see or store your full card or UPI PIN details. A recharge appears in your wallet once the payment is confirmed. If money was deducted but not credited, it is normally corrected automatically within a few hours; if not, write to info@zodiacpluss.com with the payment reference.

## 4. Taxes

GST at 18% is added to bookings where it applies, and is shown before you pay. Your transaction history shows the amount, the tax and the total for each purchase.

## 5. What you cannot do with it

Wallet money and Zodiac Coins are prepaid credit for use on Zodiac Pluss only. They:

- cannot be withdrawn to a bank account or exchanged for cash, except where the law requires it;
- cannot be transferred to another person or account, or sold;
- do not earn interest.

## 6. Offers, coupons and bonus Coins

Offers, coupons and bonus credit have their own conditions, which are shown with them, including any expiry date. Bonus credit that expires or is cancelled under those conditions is removed from your balance. Promotional credit is not refundable.

## 7. Refunds into the wallet

Refunds for cancelled bookings return to their original source, as the Refund Policy explains. A refund to your wallet is credited immediately and can be used again straight away.

## 8. Closing your account

If your account is permanently deleted (after the grace period of 60 days, during which you can cancel the deletion by signing in), **the wallet balance and Zodiac Coins left at that point are forfeited.** Use or ask about your balance before you delete your account. We cannot delete an account while a session is live, a booking is confirmed or a payout is unsettled.

## 9. Fraud and misuse

We may freeze a wallet and reverse credits if we find fraud, a chargeback dispute, payment abuse, or a breach of the Terms. We will tell you why unless the law prevents us.

## 10. Questions

Write to info@zodiacpluss.com, with your registered mobile number and the transaction reference. Zodiac Pluss, Building no. 199, Pocket 20, North West Delhi, New Delhi - 110085.

community-guidelines.title: Community Guidelines
community-guidelines.content:
# Community Guidelines

**Effective from 1 October 2026**

Zodiac Pluss brings people and experts together to talk about things that matter, sometimes private and difficult things. These guidelines set out how everyone on the platform, users and experts alike, should behave so that it stays safe and respectful. They are part of the Terms & Conditions of Zodiac Pluss ("**Zodiac Pluss**", "we", "us").

## 1. Be respectful

- Treat everyone with courtesy. No harassment, bullying, threats, hate speech, or insults, whether about a person's religion, caste, gender, sexuality, disability, region, appearance or beliefs.
- No sexual content, sexual advances or sexual language. Sessions are for guidance and support.
- No stalking, repeated unwanted contact, or contacting someone who has asked you to stop.

## 2. Keep it honest

- Use your own real details. Do not impersonate anyone or invent credentials.
- Experts: describe your qualifications and experience truthfully. Do not guarantee outcomes, claim to cure or diagnose, or make fear-based predictions to pressure a client.
- Users: do not make false complaints, or ask for a refund for a session that did not go wrong.
- No fraud, payment abuse or manipulation of reviews, offers or referrals.

## 3. Protect privacy

- What is said in a session stays in the session. Do not screenshot, record, forward, post or sell a session or someone's personal details without their permission.
- Do not share someone else's phone number, address, photos or private information.
- Keep the conversation on Zodiac Pluss. Do not ask someone to take you to another channel, or to pay you directly, to avoid the platform.

## 4. Safety comes first

- If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call your local emergency number. For emotional distress in India you can call Tele-MANAS on 14416 (free, 24 hours).
- Zodiac Pluss is not an emergency service, and an expert may not be reachable the moment you need help.
- If we believe someone is at serious and immediate risk, we may act to protect them, sharing only what is necessary.
- Do not use the Services to plan or encourage harm to yourself or to anyone else, or to commit a crime.

## 5. What experts must not do

- Give medical, legal or financial instructions, or tell a client to stop treatment or medication.
- Diagnose a condition or promise a result.
- Use a client's trust, fear, grief or a crisis to sell more sessions, remedies or products.
- Share what a client said, or contact them outside the platform about anything unrelated.

## 6. Reporting a problem

You can report a user, an expert or a message from the app, or write to info@zodiacpluss.com. Tell us what happened and when. We treat reports seriously and in confidence; we will not tell the person you reported who made the report.

## 7. What happens if the guidelines are broken

Depending on how serious it is and whether it has happened before, we may:

- warn the person;
- remove content or limit what they can do;
- suspend or permanently remove the account;
- withhold or reverse earnings or credit connected to the breach;
- report to the police or other authorities where the law requires or the risk is serious.

If you think we got a decision wrong, write to info@zodiacpluss.com and we will look again.

## 8. Changes

We may update these guidelines. When a change matters we publish a new version and ask you to accept it. The version and date are shown at the top.

**Contact:** Zodiac Pluss, Building no. 199, Pocket 20, North West Delhi, New Delhi - 110085 · info@zodiacpluss.com

expert-agreement.title: Expert Agreement
expert-agreement.content:
# Expert Agreement

**Effective from 1 October 2026**

This agreement is between Zodiac Pluss ("**Zodiac Pluss**", "we", "us") and you, the astrologer, psychologist or counsellor ("**expert**", "you") who offers services through the Zodiac Pluss platform. It applies together with the Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy, Refund Policy and Community Guidelines. If they conflict on a point about experts, this agreement applies.

By submitting your application or accepting this agreement you confirm that you have read and agree to it.

## 1. Your status

You are an **independent professional**, not an employee, partner or agent of Zodiac Pluss. You decide how you give your advice, within the law and our Community Guidelines. You are responsible for your own tax registration and filings, and for any licences your work requires. Zodiac Pluss provides the platform, clients, payments and support.

## 2. Eligibility and verification

You must be 18 or older and legally able to work in India. Before you are listed you will give us accurate **identity (KYC) details, your qualifications and certificates, and your bank details for payment.** We may verify them with the issuers and may ask for more at any time. You promise that everything you give us is true, current and yours, and that you will tell us promptly if it changes.

Experts offering therapy or counselling must hold the qualifications and any registration required to practise in the way they describe themselves. You must not present yourself as having a qualification, licence or experience you do not have. A false claim is grounds for immediate removal.

Changes to your profile, prices or certificates may need our approval before they go live.

## 3. How you work on the platform

- Be available when you say you are, and answer requests promptly. Do not leave a client waiting without telling them.
- Give honest, careful advice within your area of competence. **Never guarantee outcomes**, claim to cure or diagnose, or pressure a client to buy anything.
- **Astrologers** must not give medical, psychological, legal or financial instructions, or frighten clients with predictions of harm.
- **Therapists and counsellors** must follow the professional and ethical standards of your discipline, and refer a client who needs more than the platform can offer, or emergency help, to the right place. If a client may be in immediate danger, follow our safety process and the law.
- Keep all sessions on the platform. Do not ask a client to move to another channel to avoid fees, or to pay you directly.
- Treat clients with respect and follow the Community Guidelines.

## 4. Confidentiality and client data

What clients tell you is confidential. You will use it only to help that client, will not share, copy, post or sell it, and will not contact a client outside the platform about anything unrelated. Do not screenshot, forward or record a session outside the platform. These duties continue after you leave Zodiac Pluss.

## 5. Recording

**Voice calls with astrologers are recorded automatically**, with no question asked before each call. The recording is available to you and the client from the session chat and to our staff for support, safety, dispute and legal reasons. **Therapy and counselling sessions are never recorded.** You agree to this recording as a condition of taking astrology calls.

## 6. Fees, payments and tax

- **Pricing.** You set your prices within the options the platform offers. The client pays Zodiac Pluss and we pay you.
- **Platform fee.** We keep a platform fee on each session, as shown in your earnings and payout statements.
- **Deductions.** Payouts are made after deducting the platform fee and any tax we are required by law to deduct, such as TDS, and GST where it applies. Each payout statement shows every deduction.
- **Payouts.** Earnings are paid to your verified bank account. The minimum payout is **₹100**, and payouts are made automatically about every **30 days** once your balance reaches the minimum.
- **Refunds.** If a session or booking is refunded to a client under the Refund Policy, the earnings for it are reversed. If it is reversed after we have already paid you, we may deduct it from your next payout.
- **Levels.** Your standing on the platform may be reviewed weekly, based on factors such as availability, response and client feedback. Levels can change what you are shown and offered.

## 7. Cancellations and no-shows

If you cancel a booking or do not attend, the client is refunded in full. Repeated cancellations, missed bookings or leaving clients waiting can lead to lower visibility, suspension or removal.

## 8. Intellectual property and reputation

You keep ownership of your content. You give Zodiac Pluss a licence to show your name, photo, profile and listed details to clients on the platform and in our promotion of the platform. You will not use our name or brand in a way that suggests we endorse you beyond your listing.

## 9. Conduct, suspension and ending

We may suspend or remove you, with or without notice, for breaking this agreement, the Terms or the Community Guidelines, for a serious complaint, for false information, or where the law or safety requires. You may stop offering services at any time by closing your account in the app, after finishing live sessions and confirmed bookings. A deleted expert account follows the process and grace period of **30 days** in the Privacy Policy. Money earned and payable to you for completed sessions is paid out after deductions, unless it is subject to a complaint or a legal hold.

## 10. Liability

You are responsible for the advice you give. To the extent the law allows, Zodiac Pluss is not liable for your advice or for loss a client suffers because of it, and you will compensate us for claims and costs that arise from your breach of this agreement, false information, or unlawful conduct. Nothing limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

## 11. Changes

We may update this agreement. When a change matters we publish a new version and ask you to accept it before you carry on. If you do not accept, you may stop offering services and close your account.

## 12. Law and contact

This agreement is governed by the laws of India. Courts at Delhi, India have jurisdiction. Questions: info@zodiacpluss.com.

Zodiac Pluss
Building no. 199, Pocket 20, North West Delhi, New Delhi - 110085
